tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Look up one product at Bearded Colonel by name and return its price, the frequencies available, stock and category. Read-only. Some products carry no written description, so follow the link for the full page.

name.description: The product name, or part of it.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: What Bearded Colonel is, and the main sections of the site with links. Read-only. Use it first to see what the site covers.

tools.name: get_subscription_terms
tools.description: How subscriptions work at Bearded Colonel: commitment, changing delivery frequency, pausing and cancelling. Read-only.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The product categories at Bearded Colonel, with how many products each holds and a link. Read-only.

tools.name: list_delivery_options
tools.description: Where Bearded Colonel delivers and what postage costs. Postage is charged by item type and is free above an order threshold, so this returns both. Read-only. The figure for a particular basket is confirmed at checkout.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search the pages and articles on Bearded Colonel and return the matches with a short extract and a link. Read-only.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the products Bearded Colonel sells and return the matches with prices, subscription terms, stock and links. Read-only: it does not add anything to a basket or place an order.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

limit.description: How many products to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.
